status_note: Catalog confirms hosted edition files for 2005–2027. For 2004, a community Excel extract is described but unverified. FIFA 2000–2003 remain without verified structured player files (a community archive describes raw, partly unextractable DBI formats).
game_year_vs_calendar: FIFA 2005 corresponds to 2004/05 football season, not calendar 2005 squad or FIFA game released in 2005.
